items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Lilly arranged for me to give a cocktail party for them at the reception offices of Ricard

ctx.x: I assisted in one of the post picturesque weddings I had ever seen. This happened in a part of Paris known as the Commune libre de la Butte Montmarte which is the surrounding of the famous Sacred Heart Church (Sacré Coeur). The marriage was that of a well known Gipsy Violinist Roman Jacowlew to a Miss Pilar Gonzales, a spanish actress. After the wedding ceremony, I lead a parade of montmartrois and Montmartroises (as the people from the Butte Montmarte are called) are dressed in picturesque clothes from the last…

A few days later, the Jazz at Philharmonic was giving a concert at Salle Pleyel. I knew weeks before when they would be in town,so Lilly arranged for me to give a cocktail party for them at the reception offices of Ricard, the makers of the well known appetizer. Roy Eldridge, Lester Young, Ray Brown, Joe Benjamin and Norman Grantz the organiser of the J.A.T.P. came to the cocktail. But there is a story about this cocktail that was very embarrassing for me.
The cocktail was supposed to start at 6 p.m. and finished at 8, and as I was the host, I was supposed to be there before the guests
